guidance.opening:
秋日的波士顿，一间租务办公室里纸张堆得老高，窗缝漏进潮冷的风。房东史蒂文·诺特把一叠租约推到一边，指尖敲了敲桌面。

「我是史蒂文·诺特。刚继承了一处旧宅，邻居都叫它科比特宅。上一户马卡里奥一家出事跑了，有人进了疗养院，没人肯再住。我需要人白天去弄清楚房子出了什么问题，好把名声洗干净——报纸、档案厅、街坊、旧租客，都行。」

他抬眼打量来客，停顿一下。

「你是哪位？平时做什么营生？」
guidance.advice: 1920s Boston. Occupations must use only listed names: Antiquarian, Artist, Athlete, Author, Clergy, Criminal, Dilettante, Doctor of Medicine, Drifter, Engineer, Entertainer, Farmer, Hacker, Journalist, Lawyer, Librarian, Military Officer, Missionary, Musician, Parapsychologist, Pilot, Police Detective, Police Officer, Private Investigator, Professor, Soldier, Tribe Member, Zealot. Prefer era-fitting public roles that could be asked to look into a vacant rental (Journalist, Private Investigator, Lawyer, Librarian, Professor, Police Detective, Antiquarian, Author, Parapsychologist, Doctor of Medicine, Clergy); treat Hacker and Tribe Member as poor fits unless the player insists. Useful training: Library Use, History, Law, Spot Hidden, Persuade, Psychology, Occult as optional flavor not as confirmed Mythos knowledge. Languages: English is assumed; optional Italian could help with former tenants later, Latin with old records—do not invent scores. Belongings: notebook, fountain pen, street clothes, trolley fare, calling cards; no house keys, cash advance, or maps from Knott yet. Public involvement: a landlord seeking a day-hire to check why tenants fled and restore a property's name; neighbors rumoring the Corbitt House. Optional ties (player choice, not facts): acquaintance of the Macarios, prior work for Knott, newspaper curiosity, church charity. Do not force occupation, age interview, or commission. Preserve uncertainty: wrongness is rumor. Setup tool writes the card after identity talk.
guidance.handoff: The visitor is in Knott's Office with Steven Knott. He has stated the public premise (inherited Corbitt House, Macarios fled after a disaster, some in an asylum, he wants the reputation cleared) and asked who the visitor is and what they do. Identity and occupation are not yet decided. No commission accepted, no keys, money, address packet, or research brief handed over. Continue from this same meeting once the investigator card exists; do not restage arrival.
